description: The lease table of a DHCP server: data source 4. Several providers may be active at once (one server per scope); the kind runs the client identity cascade on what they report.

functions.description: Called at every probe round: asks the firewall whether this implementation can be read and whether its configuration serves clients.
functions.name: probe

functions.description: Called at every lease pass: the server's current lease table.
functions.name: leases

fields.description: Why the probe could not finish, when it could not.
fields.name: error

fields.description: The `dhcp_lease_record` records read, absent when the read failed.
fields.name: leases

fields.description: Why the read failed, when it did; the result then says what the firewall answered.
fields.name: error

fields.description: Why this implementation's material can never be read, when that is so: a state, recorded with its reason, and not a failure.
fields.name: unsupported

records.description: One lease generation, with the field-name differences between backends normalised away.
records.name: dhcp_lease_record

fields.description: The hardware address; the host lower-cases it and stores a value that is not six colon-separated octets as absent.
fields.name: mac

fields.description: The host name the client sent.
fields.name: hostname

fields.description: The vendor the server names for the address.
fields.name: vendor_hint

fields.description: The interface's configuration key, when the server names it.
fields.name: interface_identifier

fields.description: The interface's network device, when the server names it.
fields.name: interface_device

fields.description: The validity start, only when the server reports one; never substituted.
fields.name: starts_at
